posts.title: Regal Cheshire Moon
posts.description: Picking up dinner I looked up and the moon was a Cheshire Cat grinning down on me.

posts.title: Soft pink sunrise
posts.description: This morning had the most beautiful soft pink sunrise. It had long tendrils of color streaking across the sky. I went outside to take this picture before the colors changed. It always goes so quick.

posts.title: Seneca Creek State Park Winter Lights Festival
posts.description: Rode through the Seneca Creek State Park Winter Lights Festival with my friend John and his family in Yukon Cornelius. It’s fun looking at Christmas lights with a group. The big caterpillar reminded me of Alice in Wonderland.
